15.title: AI generated query consumption by type - Usage over Time
15.description:
**AI-Generated Query Consumption by Hour**

Tracks hourly billing for AI-generated queries across logs, events, and traces. Line chart reveals cost trends and peak usage patterns over the past week.
15.query:
fetch dt.system.events, from: -7d
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| filter in(event.type, {
    "Log Management & Analytics - Query",
    "Events - Query",
    "Traces - Query"
  })
| filter ai_generated == true
| dedup {event.id, event.type}
| fieldsAdd hour = bin(timestamp, 1h)
| summarize billed_bytes = sum(billed_bytes), by: {hour, event.type}
| fieldsAdd billed_gib = round(toDouble(billed_bytes) / 1073741824, decimals: 3)
| fields hour, event.type, billed_gib
| sort hour asc, event.type asc

37.description:
**Total AI Units Consumed**

Displays cumulative AI Units usage across your environment. Single value format provides at-a-glance visibility into overall AI service consumption for cost tracking and quota management.
37.query:
fetch dt.system.events, scanLimitGBytes: -1
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| filter event.type == "AI Units"
| dedup event.id
| makeTimeseries Units_day = sum(if(exists(usage.quantity.billable), usage.quantity.billable, else: 1)), interval: 24h, time: timestamp
| fieldsadd Units=arraySum(Units_day)
| fieldsRename `AI Units` =  Units

38.description:
**AI-Incurred Standard Function Calls**

Displays total AI Standard Function calls billed over the selected timeframe. Single value format provides quick cost tracking and usage insights at a glance.
38.query:
fetch dt.system.events, scanLimitGBytes: -1
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| filter event.type =="AI Function Standard Call"
| dedup event.id
| makeTimeseries invocations_day = sum(if(exists(billed_invocations), billed_invocations, else: 1)),
  interval: 24h,
  time: timestamp
| fieldsadd invocations=arraySum(invocations_day)
| fieldsRename `Standard Function Calls (AI)` =  invocations

39.description:
**AI-Generated Query Consumption**

Tracks daily billed bytes from AI-generated queries across Log, Events, and Traces. Single value display provides quick visibility into total consumption costs.
39.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| filter in(event.type, {"Log Management & Analytics - Query","Events - Query","Traces - Query"})
| filter ai_generated == true
| dedup event.id
| makeTimeseries data_read_bytes = sum(coalesce(billed_bytes,1) / 1073741824.0),
  interval: 24h,
  time: timestamp
| fieldsadd billed_bytes=arraySum(data_read_bytes)
| fieldsRename `Billed Bytes` =  billed_bytes

41.title: Overall trend
41.description:
**AI-Generated Costs by Capability**

Hourly cost trend split by AI units, Standard Function Calls and Agentic AI-related query consumption (Logs, Events, Traces) — reveals when and which capability is driving cost spikes relative to the peak hour.
41.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| filter in(event.type, {"Log Management & Analytics - Query","Events - Query","Traces - Query","Digital Experience Monitoring - Query","AI Function Standard Call","AI Units"})
| dedup event.id
| makeTimeseries {
    cost_logquery = sum(if(event.type == "Log Management & Analytics - Query" AND ai_generated == true, toDouble(coalesce(billed_bytes, 0)) / 1073741824.0 * 0.0035, else: 0.0)),
    cost_eventsquery = sum(if(event.type == "Events - Query" AND ai_generated == true, toDouble(coalesce(billed_bytes, 0)) / 1073741824.0 * 0.0035, else: 0.0)),
    cost_tracequery = sum(if(event.type == "Traces - Query" AND ai_generated == true, toDouble(coalesce(billed_bytes, 0)) / 1073741824.0 * 0.0035, else: 0.0)),
    cost_AI = sum(if(event.type == "AI Units", toDouble(coalesce(usage.quantity.billable, 0)) * 0.10, else: 0.0)),
    cost_standard = sum(if(event.type == "AI Function Standard Call", toDouble(coalesce(billed_invocations, 0)) * 0.001, else: 0.0))
  }, interval: 1h
| fieldsAdd total_cost = cost_logquery[] + cost_eventsquery[] + cost_tracequery[] + cost_AI[] + cost_standard[]
| fieldsAdd peak = arrayMax(total_cost)
| fieldsAdd lq_pct = if(peak > 0, cost_logquery[] * 100.0 / peak, else: 0.0)
| fieldsAdd eq_pct = if(peak > 0, cost_eventsquery[] * 100.0 / peak, else: 0.0)
| fieldsAdd tq_pct = if(peak > 0, cost_tracequery[] * 100.0 / peak, else: 0.0)
| fieldsAdd ai_pct = if(peak > 0, cost_AI[] * 100.0 / peak, else: 0.0)
| fieldsAdd st_pct = if(peak > 0, cost_standard[] * 100.0 / peak, else: 0.0)
| fieldsAdd series = array(record(capability = "Log Query", pct = lq_pct),record(capability = "Events Query", pct = eq_pct),record(capability = "Trace Query", pct = tq_pct), record(capability = "AI Units", pct = ai_pct), record(capability = "Standard Function Calls (AI)", pct = st_pct))
| expand series
| fieldsFlatten series
| fields capability = series.capability, pct = series.pct, timeframe, interval

67.title: Number of workflows using Agentic AI
67.description:
**Agentic Workflow Usage Summary  (amount)**

Displays total count of distinct workflows consuming AI units.
67.query:
fetch dt.system.events, scanLimitGBytes: -1
| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| filter event.type == "AI Units"
| dedup event.id| filter in(event.type, array("AI Units", "AI Function Standard Call"))
| filter isNotNull(workflow.execution.id)
| dedup event.id
| sort timestamp asc
| summarize steps = count(), sequence = collectArray(tool),
    by: { workflow.id, workflow.execution.id }
| summarize { 
    workflows=countDistinctExact(workflow.id), 
    workflow_execs = countDistinctExact(workflow.execution.id)
  }
